cards.example: Costco Gold Star costs $65 and Executive $130 with a 2% reward up to $1,250, so Executive pays off above $3,250 spend (reported, 2026, checked October 2026).
cards.value: $35 net at $5,000 spend on Executive, up to $1,185 at the cap, or $65 saved by cancelling unused memberships
cards.odds: Low risk. Savings depend on the user actually shopping there.
steps: Sums 12 months of club spend from card data and spots the renewal charge date.
Shows the break-even math and asks to upgrade, downgrade or cancel.
Gives the steps or makes the change, then checks the next renewal charge.
cards.needs: Card feed, membership account access

upmore.note: "is costco executive worth it": 12 months of the person's own Costco charges against the tier fees and the 2% reward cap from the dated offer book, the break-even and the verdict; making the change and checking the next renewal charge are not built; one_approval: a cancel goes to the cancel flow with its own yes

evidence.test: costco: the break-even and the verdict from 12 months of the person's own Costco charges

cards.title: Amazon Subscribe and Save 5-item stack
cards.what: Group five or more subscriptions on one monthly delivery date to lift the discount from 5% to 15%.
cards.example: Slickdeals reported 5% off for up to four items and 15% for five or more on the same date (reported, 2022, checked October 2026).
cards.value: An extra 10% on household staples, so $60 to $240 a year on $50 to $200 a month
cards.effort: 20 minutes once, then 2 minutes a month
cards.odds: Prices can rise after the first order. Dropping to four items cuts the discount back to 5%.
steps: Reads Amazon order emails to find repeat staples and current subscriptions.
Proposes moving five or more to one date and shows the extra saving.
After approval, checks each upcoming delivery price and flags spikes before it ships.
cards.needs: Email access, Amazon order history, price history data

cards.value: Hundreds to many thousands of dollars per hospital bill

Shows the hospital's posted assistance policy and likely fit, and asks to prepare an application.
